description: Mocha CommonJS projects should preserve their native command, callable require assertion evidence, and lib-root plan shape.

lockedFields.reason: The plan should preserve the package's Mocha test script.
Mocha dependency, config, command, and test-location signals provide high-confidence setup evidence.
The untested catalog client should remain one add-test candidate.
The parser's existing Mocha test should be extended rather than duplicated.
The covered lib-root parser should remain the first review target.
A callable CommonJS export passed into Node assert should remain asserted provenance.
The plan should reuse the existing Mocha test location.
The untested external service boundary should receive a focused unit-test recommendation.

allowedVariations: Rationale wording may change while retaining the native Mocha/CommonJS strategy.
Additional non-locked metadata may be added.
unexpectedVariations: Duplicating the existing parser test instead of extending it.
